show.description: To fulfill his grandfather’s dying wish, a secretive multi-billionaire lives undercover as a lowly toilet sweeper, navigating a contractual marriage to a struggling CEO while using his hidden influence and lethal skills to dismantle her corporate enemies and underworld threats.
